edition.title: The World in Brief · Contextual Cloze · 13 November 2026
edition.summary_zh: 8篇原创新闻语境，24个单词填空。
edition.source_label: The Economist · 订阅邮件学习版

items.example: After Jensen Huang stepped down as Nvidia's chief executive, investors faced an abrupt leadership change.
items.analysis_zh: step down as + 职务表示卸任、辞去领导职务。这里用过去式 stepped，与 faced 对应。resigned as 同样符合句法及基本语义，可作为可接受答案。
items.cloze: After Jensen Huang ______ down as Nvidia's chief executive, investors faced an abrupt leadership change.
items.why_zh: step down as + 职务表示卸任、辞去领导职务。这里用过去式 stepped，与 faced 对应。resigned as 同样符合句法及基本语义，可作为可接受答案。

items.example: The company pledged large sums to AI startups and had signed major data-centre leases.
items.analysis_zh: pledge money/funds to + 对象表示承诺提供资金，比 commit 更突出明确作出的承诺。句子是过去发生的承诺，因此用 pledged。
items.cloze: The company ______ large sums to AI startups and had signed major data-centre leases.
items.why_zh: pledge money/funds to + 对象表示承诺提供资金，比 commit 更突出明确作出的承诺。句子是过去发生的承诺，因此用 pledged。

items.example: Interim boss Colette Kress must reassure partners that these deals stand.
items.analysis_zh: deals stand 表示协议仍然有效或继续成立。stand 在这里是不及物动词，主语是复数 deals，使用原形；remain valid 也可表达同义，但不符合单词空的形式。
items.cloze: Interim boss Colette Kress must reassure partners that these deals ______.
items.why_zh: deals stand 表示协议仍然有效或继续成立。stand 在这里是不及物动词，主语是复数 deals，使用原形；remain valid 也可表达同义，但不符合单词空的形式。

items.example: Donald Trump told his vice-president to focus on domestic corruption allegations rather than negotiations with Iran.
items.analysis_zh: focus on + 名词/动名词表示把注意力集中于某事。tell somebody to 后接动词原形，所以填 focus。
items.cloze: Donald Trump told his vice-president to ______ on domestic corruption allegations rather than negotiations with Iran.
items.why_zh: focus on + 名词/动名词表示把注意力集中于某事。tell somebody to 后接动词原形，所以填 focus。

items.example: The president insisted that America controlled the Strait of Hormuz and argued that a deal was no longer necessary.
items.analysis_zh: insist that + 从句表示坚持声称某事为真，语气比 say 强。该句与 argued 并列，采用过去式 insisted。
items.cloze: The president ______ that America controlled the Strait of Hormuz and argued that a deal was no longer necessary.
items.why_zh: insist that + 从句表示坚持声称某事为真，语气比 say 强。该句与 argued 并列，采用过去式 insisted。

items.example: Vance was reportedly considering direct talks with an Iranian official.
items.analysis_zh: reportedly 是报道中的证据距离词，表示消息来自报道而未被作者直接证实；放在 was 与 considering 之间修饰整个动作。
items.cloze: Vance was ______ considering direct talks with an Iranian official.
items.why_zh: reportedly 是报道中的证据距离词，表示消息来自报道而未被作者直接证实；放在 was 与 considering 之间修饰整个动作。

items.example: Microsoft reported an outage involving Teams, Outlook and Copilot.
items.analysis_zh: an outage 指网络或软件服务中断，常搭配 service outage / widespread outage。前面的 an 提示这里需要元音音素开头的单数名词。
items.cloze: Microsoft reported an ______ involving Teams, Outlook and Copilot.
items.why_zh: an outage 指网络或软件服务中断，常搭配 service outage / widespread outage。前面的 an 提示这里需要元音音素开头的单数名词。

items.example: The company attributed the disruption to elevated infrastructure load and unexpectedly unavailable servers.
items.analysis_zh: elevated infrastructure load 指高于正常水平的系统负载。elevated 在名词 load 前作定语，比 high 更具有技术报告的正式语气。
items.cloze: The company attributed the disruption to ______ infrastructure load and unexpectedly unavailable servers.
items.why_zh: elevated infrastructure load 指高于正常水平的系统负载。elevated 在名词 load 前作定语，比 high 更具有技术报告的正式语气。

items.example: Attempts to fix the issue were not proceeding as expected.
items.analysis_zh: as expected 意为按预期，是固定表达。not proceeding as expected 表示修复进展未达到预期，expected 是过去分词，不表示这里一定有过去时动作。
items.cloze: Attempts to fix the issue were not proceeding as ______.
items.why_zh: as expected 意为按预期，是固定表达。not proceeding as expected 表示修复进展未达到预期，expected 是过去分词，不表示这里一定有过去时动作。

items.example: Richemont said its jewellery brands performed particularly strongly during the latest reporting period.
items.analysis_zh: perform strongly 是财报中描述业务表现强劲的常用搭配。句子的 said 引出过去报告期的业绩，因此用 performed。
items.cloze: Richemont said its jewellery brands ______ particularly strongly during the latest reporting period.
items.why_zh: perform strongly 是财报中描述业务表现强劲的常用搭配。句子的 said 引出过去报告期的业绩，因此用 performed。

items.example: Sales rose even as the broader luxury industry faced headwinds from weak Chinese demand and instability in the Middle East.
items.analysis_zh: face headwinds 指面临不利因素，headwinds 原意是逆风，在财经报道中常指需求疲软等外部阻力。与 tailwinds（顺风因素）形成对比。
items.cloze: Sales rose even as the broader luxury industry faced ______ from weak Chinese demand and instability in the Middle East.
items.why_zh: face headwinds 指面临不利因素，headwinds 原意是逆风，在财经报道中常指需求疲软等外部阻力。与 tailwinds（顺风因素）形成对比。

items.example: The company reported a substantial increase in net profit.
items.analysis_zh: net profit 是净利润，区别于 revenue（营收）及 gross profit（毛利润）。本句为固定财务术语 net profit。
items.cloze: The company reported a substantial increase in net ______.
items.why_zh: net profit 是净利润，区别于 revenue（营收）及 gross profit（毛利润）。本句为固定财务术语 net profit。

items.example: Vladimir Putin said Russia would not compromise on its conditions for ending the war in Ukraine.
items.analysis_zh: compromise on + 条件/原则表示在特定要求上让步。would not 后接动词原形，故用 compromise；它既可作动词也可作名词。
items.cloze: Vladimir Putin said Russia would not ______ on its conditions for ending the war in Ukraine.
items.why_zh: compromise on + 条件/原则表示在特定要求上让步。would not 后接动词原形，故用 compromise；它既可作动词也可作名词。

items.example: He insisted that Russia would control territories it claims to have annexed.
items.analysis_zh: insist that + 从句，强调发言人坚持某个立场。这里用 insisted 与叙述时态一致；新闻中此词不代表所述内容已获独立证实。
items.cloze: He ______ that Russia would control territories it claims to have annexed.
items.why_zh: insist that + 从句，强调发言人坚持某个立场。这里用 insisted 与叙述时态一致；新闻中此词不代表所述内容已获独立证实。

items.example: Moscow also ruled out foreign peacekeepers in those areas.
items.analysis_zh: rule out + 名词表示排除某种可能或选项。Moscow 是机构转喻，意为俄罗斯当局；过去式 ruled 对应新闻叙述时间。
items.cloze: Moscow also ______ out foreign peacekeepers in those areas.
items.why_zh: rule out + 名词表示排除某种可能或选项。Moscow 是机构转喻，意为俄罗斯当局；过去式 ruled 对应新闻叙述时间。

items.example: The FBI accused state-backed North Korean hackers of stealing cryptocurrency through fake video calls.
items.analysis_zh: accuse somebody of doing something 是固定句型，表示指控某人做某事。of 后接 stealing 这一动名词；accused 属于过去式。
items.cloze: The FBI ______ state-backed North Korean hackers of stealing cryptocurrency through fake video calls.
items.why_zh: accuse somebody of doing something 是固定句型，表示指控某人做某事。of 后接 stealing 这一动名词；accused 属于过去式。

items.example: Investigators said hundreds of victims had been duped by the scheme.
items.analysis_zh: be duped by + 人/骗局表示被欺骗，语气比 be misled 更强调上当受骗。had been duped 是过去完成时被动语态。
items.cloze: Investigators said hundreds of victims had been ______ by the scheme.
items.why_zh: be duped by + 人/骗局表示被欺骗，语气比 be misled 更强调上当受骗。had been duped 是过去完成时被动语态。

items.example: Officials alleged that stolen proceeds were helping to finance an illicit weapons programme.
items.analysis_zh: proceeds 在这里作复数形式的名词，指活动或交易产生的收入，犯罪语境中可指非法所得。注意与动词 proceed（继续进行）区分。
items.cloze: Officials alleged that stolen ______ were helping to finance an illicit weapons programme.
items.why_zh: proceeds 在这里作复数形式的名词，指活动或交易产生的收入，犯罪语境中可指非法所得。注意与动词 proceed（继续进行）区分。

items.example: Forest fires in Indonesia engulfed parts of South-East Asia in toxic smoke.
items.analysis_zh: engulf ... in smoke 表示烟雾吞没或笼罩某地，engulf 强调范围大、程度强。句中 fires 是主语，engulfed 为过去式。
items.cloze: Forest fires in Indonesia ______ parts of South-East Asia in toxic smoke.
items.why_zh: engulf ... in smoke 表示烟雾吞没或笼罩某地，engulf 强调范围大、程度强。句中 fires 是主语，engulfed 为过去式。

items.example: Climate scientists estimated that temperatures during the peak fire season were substantially higher because of human-caused warming.
items.analysis_zh: estimate that + 从句用于呈现研究人员的估算结论，保留不确定性。estimated 与叙述中的过去时一致；区别于证明性的 demonstrate。
items.cloze: Climate scientists ______ that temperatures during the peak fire season were substantially higher because of human-caused warming.
items.why_zh: estimate that + 从句用于呈现研究人员的估算结论，保留不确定性。estimated 与叙述中的过去时一致；区别于证明性的 demonstrate。

items.example: Conditions were made worse by El Niño.
items.analysis_zh: make something worse 表示使情况恶化，worse 是 bad 的比较级。were made worse 是被动结构，后接 by El Niño 说明加剧因素。
items.cloze: Conditions were made ______ by El Niño.
items.why_zh: make something worse 表示使情况恶化，worse 是 bad 的比较级。were made worse 是被动结构，后接 by El Niño 说明加剧因素。

items.example: Japanese banks have benefited from the end of negative interest rates, which improved their lending margins.
items.analysis_zh: benefit from + 事件/政策表示从某项变化中受益。have benefited 是现在完成时，强调过去的利率政策变化对当前利润率仍有影响。
items.cloze: Japanese banks have ______ from the end of negative interest rates, which improved their lending margins.
items.why_zh: benefit from + 事件/政策表示从某项变化中受益。have benefited 是现在完成时，强调过去的利率政策变化对当前利润率仍有影响。

items.example: Inflation has eroded the value of deposits, prompting savers to seek higher returns elsewhere.
items.analysis_zh: erode the value of ... 表示逐渐侵蚀价值，常用于通胀削弱购买力。has eroded 是现在完成时，强调累积影响。
items.cloze: Inflation has ______ the value of deposits, prompting savers to seek higher returns elsewhere.
items.why_zh: erode the value of ... 表示逐渐侵蚀价值，常用于通胀削弱购买力。has eroded 是现在完成时，强调累积影响。

items.example: Banks are expanding into brokerage and wealth-management services to retain customers.
items.analysis_zh: expand into + 业务领域表示进入或拓展至新领域。are expanding 是现在进行时，描述银行正在推进的业务转型。
items.cloze: Banks are ______ into brokerage and wealth-management services to retain customers.
items.why_zh: expand into + 业务领域表示进入或拓展至新领域。are expanding 是现在进行时，描述银行正在推进的业务转型。

passages.title: Nvidia leadership
passages.body: After Jensen Huang {{2026-11-13-nvidia-stepped}} down as Nvidia's chief executive, investors faced an abrupt leadership change. The company {{2026-11-13-nvidia-pledged}} large sums to AI startups and had signed major data-centre leases. Interim boss Colette Kress must reassure partners that these deals {{2026-11-13-nvidia-stand}}. She must also prepare for an earnings announcement and rebuild confidence in the chipmaker's strategy.

passages.title: Iran diplomacy
passages.body: Donald Trump told his vice-president to {{2026-11-13-iran-focus}} on domestic corruption allegations rather than negotiations with Iran. The president {{2026-11-13-iran-insisted}} that America controlled the Strait of Hormuz and argued that a deal was no longer necessary. J.D. Vance was {{2026-11-13-iran-reportedly}} considering direct talks with an Iranian official. Oil prices rose after the remarks, reflecting uncertainty about the war.

passages.title: Microsoft service disruption
passages.body: Microsoft reported an {{2026-11-13-microsoft-outage}} involving Teams, Outlook and Copilot. The company attributed the disruption to {{2026-11-13-microsoft-elevated}} infrastructure load and unexpectedly unavailable servers. Attempts to fix the issue were not proceeding as {{2026-11-13-microsoft-expected}}. Some workers welcomed a brief interruption to their usual digital routines.

passages.title: Richemont profits
passages.body: Richemont said its jewellery brands {{2026-11-13-luxury-performed}} particularly strongly during the latest reporting period. Sales rose even as the broader luxury industry faced {{2026-11-13-luxury-headwinds}} from weak Chinese demand and instability in the Middle East. The company reported a substantial increase in net {{2026-11-13-luxury-profit}}. Its results illustrate how strength in one category can offset pressure elsewhere.

passages.title: Ukraine peace demands
passages.body: Vladimir Putin said Russia would not {{2026-11-13-ukraine-compromise}} on its conditions for ending the war in Ukraine. He {{2026-11-13-ukraine-insisted}} that Russia would control territories it claims to have annexed. Moscow also {{2026-11-13-ukraine-ruled}} out foreign peacekeepers in those areas. American envoys met both the Russian president and Ukraine's leader, but the competing demands remain difficult to reconcile.

passages.title: North Korean cybercrime
passages.body: The FBI {{2026-11-13-cyber-accused}} state-backed North Korean hackers of stealing cryptocurrency through fake video calls. Investigators said hundreds of victims had been {{2026-11-13-cyber-duped}} by the scheme. Officials alleged that stolen {{2026-11-13-cyber-proceeds}} were helping to finance an illicit weapons programme. The case followed earlier accusations concerning a cryptocurrency exchange.

passages.title: Indonesia forest fires
passages.body: Forest fires in Indonesia {{2026-11-13-fires-engulfed}} parts of South-East Asia in toxic smoke. Climate scientists {{2026-11-13-fires-estimated}} that temperatures during the peak fire season were substantially higher because of human-caused warming. Conditions were made {{2026-11-13-fires-worse}} by El Niño. The findings suggest that natural climate variability can amplify the effects of long-term warming.

passages.title: Japanese banks
passages.body: Japanese banks have {{2026-11-13-banking-benefited}} from the end of negative interest rates, which improved their lending margins. Inflation has {{2026-11-13-banking-eroded}} the value of deposits, prompting savers to seek higher returns elsewhere. Banks are {{2026-11-13-banking-expanding}} into brokerage and wealth-management services to retain customers. Competition for savings is also pushing institutions to offer higher deposit rates.
